## Description

Rank stocks by accruals relative to earnings/assets; avoid or short firms whose reported earnings are less cash-backed.

## Where it may fit

Long-horizon stock selection where accruals forecast weaker future returns.

## Vehicles

Equity long-short and forensic-accounting strategies.

## Required data

Point-in-time balance sheet, net income, cash flow, total assets, fiscal dates and return history.

## Caveats

Accounting schema changes, industry differences and publication lags can contaminate signals.
